title: chainindex
description: One chain's chainindex service: the ledger writing confirmed logs to ClickHouse, its RPC lanes, the verifier, live heads, reads and audits. Uses only chainindex_* metrics and the process metrics next to them.

panels.title: Tip lane last wrote
panels.description: Seconds since the tip lane finished a window. It writes one every poll; the ChainindexLedgerStalled alert fires past 600 s.

panels.title: Tip lag
panels.description: How far the tip lane trails the chain head, in chain time (blocks over the measured block rate). The floor is the confirmation depth plus one poll.

panels.title: Streams at the tip
panels.description: A stream (an address, or a kind scanned by topic) joins the tip lane once its backfill has caught up.

panels.title: Backfill ETA (rough)
panels.description: Blocks the backfill lane still owes, summed over streams, over how fast that sum fell in the last 30 min. 0 when nothing is left; huge for a while after a restart moves the tip.

panels.title: RPC not ok (15m)
panels.description: Throttled or failed requests. A throttle is waited out on the same endpoint and pauses the background lanes, so this costs speed, not data.

panels.title: Component restarts (24h)
panels.description: A component (ledger lane, reads, auditor) that crashed and was restarted by the service's supervisor.

panels.title: Audits repaired (24h)
panels.description: Windows where the auditor re-fetched logs the store lacked (or found logs the RPC no longer returns). Details in chain_<chain>.audits.

panels.title: Orphaned blocks (24h)
panels.description: Stored blocks found off the canonical chain: a fork deeper than the confirmation depth. dbt leaves their logs out.

panels.title: Verifier last checked
panels.description: Seconds since the verifier saved a checked window. It checks every 30 s once blocks are 15 minutes deep.

panels.title: Memory (process)
panels.description: Resident memory of the chainindex process. The example Deployment limits it to 1 GiB.

panels.title: Confirmed head and tip lane
panels.description: The ledger writes blocks at least the confirmation depth below the head. The tip lane advances every stream already caught up, one window per poll.

panels.title: Backfill work left (blocks, summed over streams)
panels.description: Each stream behind the tip counts the blocks it still owes. Streams share windows, so the real work is closer to the longest one than to the sum.

panels.title: Requests per second by lane and outcome
panels.description: ledger: the tip lane; backfill: history and the auditor; reads, headers and addresses: their own endpoint where the chain file gives them one. Each lane has its own budget.

panels.title: Verified range and confirmed head
panels.description: The verifier follows the head 15 minutes behind it, then walks history backwards down to the oldest stored log.

panels.title: Verifier lag (blocks)
panels.description: Blocks deep enough to verify that the verifier has not reached yet. Near zero once it has caught up.

panels.title: Seconds since the last head
panels.description: Only when live is enabled. A chain file without rpc.ws polls for heads instead.

panels.title: Head arrival latency p50 / p90
panels.description: From a block's estimated time to its head's first arrival over a websocket. It can read slightly negative when several blocks share a second.

panels.title: Reads · contract state at confirmed blocks (empty unless the chain file has reads)
Reads behind the confirmed head (blocks)
panels.description: A read runs every few blocks, so a small saw-tooth is normal.

panels.title: Failed calls and skipped blocks
panels.description: Failed: a call reverted inside the multicall (stored, decoded as NULL). Skipped: blocks older than the read's catch-up limit after downtime.

panels.title: Audits by kind and result
panels.description: recent: a window near the tip; historic: a random stored window.
